name: dotnet dotau Pty Ltd
summary: First internet provider to the Pilbara region of WA (4/9 Byass St, South Hedland), trading online as Norcom: dialup (to v.90/K56Flex) from POPs in Port/South Hedland, Newman, Tom Price and Perth; web hosting and development; internet cafes; domains norcom.net.au / pilbara.net.au / dotnet-dotau.au.com. Upstreams connect.com.au and Telstra plus an 8Mbit NetConnect satellite feed; WAIX peer; WAIA and TIO member.

events.details: Listed in the Australian ISP List by 10 Apr 1997 (entry last updated 18 Nov 1999); plans c. 1997 included Economy $20/mo (12hr) and City/Remote Premium $40-49/mo; NNTP posts of the era identify the operator as 'dotnet dotau'.
